biotools.summary: AMScorer and AMReader are tools designed to streamline the process of recording and analyzing data from arbuscular mycorrhizal colonization assays. AMScorer is an Excel spreadsheet for data recording and processing, while AMReader is an R package for visualization and statistical analysis.
